label_definition: 1=sequence present in local AbAMPdb/DBAASP panel; 0=UniProt-derived, length-matched putative-negative fragment
limitations: Negative fragments are weak labels and may have antimicrobial activity.
Lengths are sampled to match positives, but biological source and sequence-composition bias may inflate scores.
Grouping is only a leakage control, not independent external validation.
